items.name: Brow Brew
items.description:
Brow Brew is an oddity of beers, being produced primarily from grapes harvested from the vineyard of the Numerian town of Iadenveigh. The tough grapes are practically inedible, but are fermented with a particular yeast, grain and wood mushrooms to make a distinctive and rough beer considered an 'acquired taste' by visitors to the town.

items.name: Bullseye Rum
items.description:
“It hits you right in the center, just not in a good way.”
Bullseye Rum is the drink of choice for the truly desperate, the miserly, or those who simply value quantity over quality. Its dark amber hue suggests a richness it absolutely does not deliver. The label, featuring a dartboard and the motto "Bullseye," is both an ironic jab at the drink's questionable aftereffects and a promise of its unerring ability to ruin your stomach. items.name: Goldenwake Mead
items.description:
“Smooth seas on the evening, but a storm in the morning”
Goldenwake Mead is a staple in coastal taverns across the Shackles, brewed with golden honey, faint spices, and a hearty kick of alcohol. It's known for its warmth, easy drinkability, and surprising potency, making it a favorite among sailors and pirates alike. While mostly known for its pleasant effects, overindulging in this stout mead can leave even the hardiest drinker feeling slightly off-kilter.

items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 15 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionThese red and white wines grown in certain coastal vineyards have a sweet-tart flavor valued by nobles in many lands.

items.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.description: When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply spell resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.

items.name: Street Meat
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 1 cp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionUsually sold by vendors on a thin wooden stick, these small chunks of cooked meat often come from many different sorts of creatures-rats and pigeons are the most common.

items.name: Supple, A Wine By Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Calvin Carpenter's finest line of dry white wines, made from the finest potatoes from exclusive farms in Ravounel, has a name - Supple.
Enjoy a glass of premium and refined flavor.
Savor the taste and aroma of the rich, earthy notes in each bottle, expertly crafted from the finest ingredients. Raise a glass of Supple, the epitome of luxury and refinement.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 5 sp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionThe listed price is for a day's worth of food. This bland food is usually some kind of hard tack, jerky, and dried fruit, though the contents vary from region to region and the race of those creating it. As long as it stays dry, it can go for months without spoiling.

items.name: Dwarven Trail Rations
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 2 gp; Weight 1-1/2 lbs.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionDwarven trail rations consist of smoked sausages and salted meat, rounded out with hard biscuits and dried vegetables. If you are a dwarf who subsists on nothing but these rations for at least 1 week, you can hustle or make a forced march for an additional hour without ill effects, but cannot do both in the same day. items.description:

Price 2 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionA day's worth of halfling trail rations is actually more than what a typical adventuring halfling eats in a day-a full belly strengthens a halfling's resolve. Common foods include sweetened dried fruit, aged sausage, hard sharp cheese, honey cakes, and a mixture of roasted grains, nuts, and molasses. items.name: Whispered Courage Whiskey
items.description: "Drink the blood of heroes."Whispered Courage is aged in barrels made from pines cut from the Stoneheart Massacre Glade.This powerful spirit grants +4 vs fear saves for 1 hour. The bonus is doubled if an ally who also drank the whiskey is threatened within your sight.

items.name: Caydenbrew Teenie-Keg
items.description:
"One swig, one blessing, one tale to tell—or forget."

Caydenbrew Teenie-Kegs are single-serving wooden kegs of Cayden Cailean’s iconic brew, blessed in his name and crafted for adventurers, rogues, and pirates who seek fortune, bravery, and maybe just a bit of luck. Compact and practical, they’re a common sight among the devout—or those who just like to party.

Lore
Brewed with Blessings: Caydenbrew Teenie-Kegs are said to contain a drop of water from Cayden Cailean’s legendary Everlasting Tank

items.name: Gnome Trail Rations
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95
Price 2 gp; Weight 1 lb. 
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionAlmost any preserved food can be found in gnome trail rations, which are designed to keep a wandering gnome from needing to dine on the same meal twice in a week. items.name: Wack Juce
items.description:
Refreshingly intoxicating, Wack Juce is made with the finest synthetic oranges in Numeria, and the 3rd finest potato vodka in the world: Smashka Noble!
Enjoy this sweet and soothing taste of home, you can almost hear the anthem of the Fatherland as you slurp!

items.name: Plunderpress Merlot
items.description:
"Pressed with all the care and grace of a pirate’s boot—one sympathizes."
Plunderpress is the Shackles’ answer to a sailor’s thirst: rough, inconsistent, and just barely deserving of the name "wine." Made from a haphazard mix of grapes and other fruits crushed under less-than-ideal conditions (usually boots or crude shipboard presses), it’s a far cry from fine vintages. Yet, for many pirates, it’s better than risking bad water or enduring sobriety on a long voyage.
